`Scripts/dependencies/internalize_sleigh_aarch64_resources.py` is the
repository-owned, offline copier for this closure. It writes only to an
explicit external work root and emits a digest-bound MATERIALIZATION.json;
it does not download, compile, invoke Xcode, or modify the source checkout.

The release package is not committed to this repository. It may be acquired
only through Scripts/dependencies/materialize_sleigh_native_dcp03b4.sh. The
materializer verifies the selected archive before extraction, rejects links and
unsafe archive members, verifies the installed CMake targets, native libraries,
public headers, and AArch64 processor resources, and writes a deterministic
MATERIALIZATION.json record.

Normal bootstrap, build, test, Xcode generation, and application execution do
not acquire or load this package. DCP-03B4 does not enable the native backend in
MacScope and does not claim that a direct Ghidra provider has been executed on
an environment where the approved package was not materialized.
